messages:
Liz M.: Quick async — publishing plan for benchmark post + launch micro-site. TL;DR: draft ready, need final assets & QA. pinging @Sam P. for hero image, @Priya R. for copy edits. Details below.
Sam P.: got it. exporting hero in 10m. which aspect ratio? 1200x628 ok?
Liz M.: yes 1200x628 + 1:1 for socials. include transparent svg for header. :+1: 
Priya R.: I'll do copy pass after lunch. can someone drop the latest bullets?
Marco G.: dropping PR link: https://git.redwood/benchmarks/content#42 — main bullets in README. also added sample meta description.
Liz M.: thanks Marco. QA checklist: spellcheck, CTA link, GA tag, canonical. @Dana (ops) can you confirm GA container id is set in staging?
Dana (ops): Confirmed GA-UA-REDACTED is in staging. leaving a note re: cookie banner for EU. :warning: 
BenchBot: Benchmark run complete: page load 1.2s (mobile), 0.6s (desktop). artifacts: s3://bench-results/17823. See report: https://bench.redwood/report/17823
Priya R.: Copy pass done. small change to first para, and swapped CTAs: 'Try demo' -> 'Get started'. pushed to PR.
Sam P.: uploaded hero assets to /assets/launch/17823, included 1x, 2x, svg. ping @Liz M. for approval.
Liz M.: Approved. deploying to staging now. scheduling social posts for Tue 09:00 PT. @Marco G. do we have short bench excerpt for tweet?
Marco G.: Yes: 'Redwood reduces inference cost by 37% for long-form generation — benchmark + methodology linked.' Shortened on PR.
Liz M.: :rocket: Great. Blocker: Need legal ok on data claims. @Priya R. can you chase legal? Startup friendly wording ready if they push back.
Priya R.: On it. I'll follow up with legal and cc the thread. Expect reply EOD.
Liz M.: cool — if legal holds, we can go live Thu morning. If not, we'll update claim and still go live. Thanks team.
